checkpoint.title: From anywhere outdoors: Ultra Balls at Indigo Plateau, then out of Route 10's Pokemon Center

events.why: Indigo Plateau's Center has the only Mart counter near a fly point that sells Ultra Balls.
Into the Center, facing the clerk across the counter.
10 Ultra Balls ($12,000): at full HP one catches an Ekans about two times in three, a Voltorb or a Drowzee one in two.
Out of the Center to fly.
Back to Route 10's Center, where the catches start.
Healed at Route 10's nurse, the catches' home Center.

metadata.notes: Starts anywhere outdoors in Kanto and ends outside Route 10's Pokemon Center, healed: the dex collection's home Center (Route 10 is a fly point; its grass is 15 tiles north). The bag's Poke Balls (8 on the Sevii save) catch Voltorb about one time in four.
